question: Should OpenClaw accept selectable quick-fix and full-change PR templates alongside the default fallback template?
rationale: This is a contributor-workflow policy change, not a runtime bug fix, and the linked canonical issue is already marked as needing a product decision.

options.title: Accept after exact-head proof
options.body: Land this PR once the final rendered templates are proven and the quick/full contract is accepted.

options.title: Revise the templates first
options.body: Ask for narrower copy or section changes before accepting the selectable-template workflow.

options.title: Keep one default template
options.body: Reject the split and leave the current single fallback PR template as the repository contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after exact-head proof
recommendation.body: Land this PR once the final rendered templates are proven and the quick/full contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work owns the PR template and proof-policy surfaces this change depends on.
